newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ngai Lik to buy motorcycle parts makers.
newsitem.headline: Ngai Lik to buy motorcycle parts makers.

text.p: Ngai Lik Industrial Holdings Ltd has agreed to buy two private companies which design and trade motorcycle engine parts for a total HK$133.44 million, the company said in a statement issued through the stock exchange.

The company's director Sammy Tam said on Thursday that the company had entered into two purchase agreements on Wednesday to buy the two private companies but a formal announcement had yet to be published. Ngai Lik gave no further details.
The company said it requested a trading suspension of its shares on Thursday pending the release of the press announcement which is expected to appear in newspapers on Friday.
Ngai Lik shares ended up one cent Wednesday at HK$1.93.
